ModMetaData.name: Shared Joys - Pickle tests
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
In-game functional tests for Shared Joys, run by Pickle. Development only: never published.
The scenarios place buildings next to colonists the fixture already holds, invite them and read what the game did: which job each colonist took, and the reason Shared Joys gives when it cannot place a group. Royalty is required, since the meditation scenario uses its meditation spot.
